rationale: The workflow currently lacks explicit job timeouts, which can lead to runaway CI runs consuming excessive resources. Evidence from experiment batch-interactive-three--fb8b16eb65a11508 (P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT) demonstrates that adding a custom timeout (timeout-minutes) to jobs reduces elapsed time by 26.8% in a similar multi-step CI workflow. The mainbuild job runs a matrix of 6 OS configurations with Gradle builds, tests, and coverage; a 60-minute timeout provides ample headroom given historical run durations of ~16 minutes while preventing stuck runs. The cypress job runs frontend tests on a single OS; a 30-minute timeout is appropriate. This change preserves all existing build and test coverage, adds no new permissions or network access, and aligns with the pattern's safety guidance to choose an explicit budget with operational headroom.
